plugins.name: close
plugins.description: A session should not end with a list of things you now have to do. Say close and Claude sweeps the whole session for loose ends — promises it made, blocked tool calls, uncommitted work, files that never reached their destination, checks it reported as NOT RUN — then does every one that is reversible and follows from what you already asked. What comes back is a three-state ledger: CLOSED with the evidence, YOURS with the exact command, PARKED with the reason. It ends on a bare verdict so you know whether you can walk away.
